Element.Description: Weapon type used to select the target's damage response.
Base damage before the target's Damage Multiplier is applied.
Base damage for radius hits, separate from direct-hit Damage Amount. Multiplied by the target's Damage Multiplier.
Radius used for distance-based knockback falloff. Radius damage also requires the caller to enable it.
Base knockback strength before distance falloff and the target's damage response are applied. Damage Radius supplies the falloff distance.
